January 29, 2025
Claimant reported a side impact at an intersection and stated the other vehicle entered from the right against a red
signal. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative with requests for information.
March 1, 2025
Responding officer's report and two independent witnesses place the claimant's vehicle at the intersection at the time
of the collision. The other driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the crash occurred.
May 17, 2025
Photos taken at the scnee show damage to the driver's side that is largely consistent with the described impact. A few
older scratches appear in the same area, and further inspection will determine whether they predate this loss.
July 5, 2025
Claimant reports neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. No prior injury to the
same body area is known from the information gathered so far.
September 1, 2025
Claimant provided a follow-up statement adding a few small details, such as the approximate position of the other
vehicle. The core account has not changed from the initial report. Treatment records show a typical course of care
that has tapered off as the claimant improved.
September 8, 2025
Policy records confirm the driver is named on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before
coverage began. The claim remains open pending completion of the vehicle inspection.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
